name: Problem Radar
summary: Alert window for stuck vehicles, broken or money-losing lines, crowded stations and fleet upgrades.
description: Collects stuck vehicles, broken or money-losing lines, crowded stations and fleet problems into one sortable window, and upgrades old or worn vehicles through the game's Replace Vehicles window. Reads the game state only and is safe to add to an existing save.

ru.name: Problem Radar
ru.summary: Предупреждения: застрявший транспорт, сломанные и убыточные линии, полные остановки, замена парка.

de.name: Problem Radar
de.summary: Meldungen: feststeckende Fahrzeuge, defekte oder defizitäre Linien, volle Stationen, Fahrzeugersatz.

fr.name: Problem Radar
fr.summary: Alertes : véhicules bloqués, lignes coupées ou déficitaires, arrêts bondés et flotte à renouveler.

es.name: Problem Radar
es.summary: Alertas: vehículos atascados, líneas rotas o con pérdidas, paradas llenas y renovación de flota.

it.name: Problem Radar
it.summary: Avvisi: veicoli bloccati, linee interrotte o in perdita, fermate affollate e rinnovo della flotta.

nl.name: Problem Radar
nl.summary: Meldingen: vastgelopen voertuigen, kapotte of verlieslatende lijnen, volle haltes, vlootvernieuwing.

pl.name: Problem Radar
pl.summary: Alerty: zablokowane pojazdy, przerwane lub stratne linie, przepełnione przystanki i wymiana taboru.

pt_BR.name: Problem Radar
pt_BR.summary: Alertas: veículos presos, linhas quebradas ou com prejuízo, paradas lotadas e renovação da frota.

ja.name: Problem Radar
ja.summary: 立ち往生した車両、断絶・赤字路線、混雑した駅をまとめた警告ウィンドウ。古い車両の更新も。

ko.name: Problem Radar
ko.summary: 멈춘 차량, 끊기거나 적자인 노선, 혼잡한 정류장을 모은 경고 창. 낡은 차량 교체도.

zh_CN.name: Problem Radar
zh_CN.summary: 汇总受困车辆、中断或亏损线路、拥挤站点的警报窗口，并可更新老旧车辆。

zh_TW.name: Problem Radar
zh_TW.summary: 彙整受困車輛、中斷或虧損路線、擁擠站點的警報視窗，並可汰換老舊車輛。
